fields.value: area/frontend - WIP checkpoint whose PanelSortInit hook (0x00420d00) would go live in the dev ASI unverified

fields.label: Ghidra headless was unreachable from PowerShell
fields.value: bash on PATH is WSL (C:\WINDOWS\system32\bash.exe), not Git Bash. It cannot open a Windows path as an argv entry, so every pool acquire died and decomp_pc.py only ever worked from a Git Bash session. Both decomp_pc.py and ghidra_pool.ps1 now resolve Git Bash explicitly.

fields.label: The gating bucket is xref-shaped, not decomp-shaped
fields.value: Of the 213 still-gating uncertainty rows, 128 need the WRITERS of a global or the CALLERS of a function - not a decompilation. decomp_pc.py --xrefs/--callers already produces that in batch, so it is the next automated lane.

fields.label: Port hazard found (U-4508)
fields.value: The 'pool-commit skips the found-slot pointer' was never a skip - the pointer is passed in EAX (0x004777a5 sets it, the commit block pushes four stack args without touching it, callee reads in_EAX). A cdecl prototype for 0x00477450 silently drops its first argument.

fields.label: dOpenDevice is at DAT_007d3ff8+0x10
fields.value: That base offset names the whole RwDevice call surface: +0x20 = fpRenderStateSet, +0x2c = fpIm2DRenderTriangle, +0x18 = zBufferNear. Confirmed three ways by argument counts and by a float reaching a vertex, not from the layout table alone.

fields.label: capstone sweeps stop at the first bad byte
fields.value: disasm() is a generator that ends silently on an undecodable byte. A full .text sweep actually covered only to ~0x408890 and reported 0 writers for a field that has 130 accesses. A control on a known-present offset is what caught it; findoffset.py now resyncs.
